answer: Each agent must place a refundable bond before it can submit jobs, and a randomly selected peer audits a sample against the claimed result. A fraud proof forfeits the bond and earns part of it for the auditor; honest submissions recover the stake. Sybils can mirror one another’s identities, but they cannot cheaply multiply accountable work: each added identity locks fresh capital, while colluding identities risk losing it. At nadir, even a lotus of fake accounts faces the same per-account cost.
